I didn't edit `migrations/0007_add_customers.sql`. A project memory says files in `migrations/` are already applied in production and must never be edited. Changing 0007 wouldn't fix the live column, and it would make the file differ from what was actually run.

I added `migrations/0008_fix_customers.sql` instead:

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

I haven't run it. `RENAME COLUMN` works on Postgres and on SQLite 3.25 or later. I didn't check which database this project uses.

Any code that reads `customers.emial` will need to switch to `email`. A search found no other uses of the typo in the repo. If 0007 hasn't been applied anywhere yet, you can still edit it directly and drop 0008.
